sections.text: Inspection and Assembly of Pump Parts

items:
Check the impeller packing ring from mechanical wear or chemical corrosion and 
 renewed if it needed
Check the shaft protection bush and renewed it if it needed

Check the shaft and repair or renewed it check the front and back bearing and 
 renewed it if it needed.
Clean every part well
Assembly every part in reverse sequence of disassembly
After finishing assembly of the pump it must be rotated by hand.
Fixed the pump and motor on foundation alignment of pump and motor
Change the packing of stuffing box filling the pump by lub oil

Operate the pump by coordination 
 with the shift engineer.

Ensure that the pump is OK, check the 
 direction of rotation, record the 
 readings of pressure, temp., vibration, according to the technical 
 specification table at introduction, and compare with the previous reading.

text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document out lines the 
 equipment inspection 
steps I2, which must be performed
on an annually 
bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the 
 above title block.
Pump function is used to:
a) 
 Transfer of clear water to chair coal filter.
b) 
 Transfer of aced water to anion.
c) 
 Transfer of demi water to make up water tank.
d) 
 Transfer of drinking water to drinking water tank.
The first draft initiated & tested by eng.
 Ibrahim 
 Ahmed Ibrahim, reviewed 
 by maintenance director eng. Mohamed El Amshety, accepted by eng. Abd El Shafy 
 ali: general director, revised by EDEC inspection and quality control eng. 
 Samir abd El Gelil, approved by eng. Deyaa Yousif head sector of Ataka power 
 station (2x300 + 2x150 ) MW, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa El-Lethy: EDEPC inspection 
and quality control head sector.
Technical Specification
Q | 50 m3/h
H | 50 m
V | 2900 
 rpm
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery

Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, suitable lifting device
Manual puller, feeler gauges.
Work to be Carried Out
Disassembly 
of the Pump
Isolated suction and delivery valves are closed
Disconnect the motor from foundation and move it far from the pump.
Pull the pump coupling by using manual puller
Look out (withdraw) the coupling key from the shaft.
Disconnect the cooling water connection.
Screw off the nut to disconnect the impeller from shaft.
Withdraw the impeller key from shaft.
Screw off the gland flange
Take out packing.
Pull shaft protection.
Take out the shaft with front bearing and without back bearing.
Pull the front bearing from the shaft by using bearing puller.
Take out the back bearing from bearing bracket by hammering
Assembly of the Pump
Inspection and Assembly of Pump Parts
Check the impeller packing ring from mechanical wear or chemical corrosion and 
 renewed if it needed
Check the shaft protection bush and renewed it if it needed
Check the shaft and repair or renewed it check the front and back bearing and 
 renewed it if it needed.
Assembly of the Pump
Clean every part well
Assembly every part in reverse sequence of disassembly
After finishing assembly of the pump it must be rotated by hand.
Fixed the pump and motor on foundation alignment of pump and motor
Change the packing of stuffing box filling the pump by lub oil
Return Pump into Service
Operate the pump by coordination 
 with the shift engineer.
Ensure that the pump is OK, check the 
 direction of rotation, record the 
 readings of pressure, temp., vibration, according to the technical 
 specification table at introduction, and compare with the previous reading.
